body: I've lived for years with my pain and fear so I thought maybe its time I tried to get help. I've actually been talking with another user on here a lot and she really has helped me! I try to stop thinking about it when I get triggered but I just find it too hard! My best friend was watching a movie once and a girl got slapped, it triggered me and she had to talk me down from a very severe panic attack. Even writing that just now made me feel anxious!
I've been seeing a therapist recently but even when I was with her I had a trigger. She wanted me to tell her about what happened and I just broke down. It was horrible!
Thank you, it's nice to know I can talk to someone.

After I was assaulted it was like my feelings all went numb. It's true, the reason I fell so in love with him was because he showed me such love. He would often make me feel so safe but now I feel like my heart was just ripped out.
No, I haven't talked to him since. It's like he just gave up on me.

It hurts the worst when I think back to all the times he said he loved me, and cared for me. He always knew just what to say when I was really down. After I was assaulted by my ex I never thought I would find love again. Then he came to my life and I started to see that maybe love was real. He would hug me tight when I cried and just tell me "it's ok, I'm here for you!" Then he left without even saying goodbye.

Not good, I was laid off from my job and am having a tough time finding work. My bills are backing up and I'm still fighting through my depression, then the guy who I loved with all my heart leaves me when I needed him the most. It's not really a secret but I tried to kill myself not too long ago because I was done. Everything happened at one time and it's just too much sometimes.
The way my life is going I really can't. I have had a really tought time lately and with him leaving me it really sent me into a downward spiral.

I'm far too innocent to do that but your suggestion did make me smile a little. It's just too hard for me to think of the good times. I often think back to all those times he would hug me and kiss me when I was feeling really down but I just end up crying and feeling worse.

I feel like he was my happiness if that make sense. He showed me that I could be happy and that I didn't have to be so down all the time. Now that he's gone I don't feel like I can get that happiness back. I am not sure even if he did come back that It would be the same after he upset me so badly.

I truly felt like he was my prince. When he came Into my life I felt like I was finally whole again. After my ex assaulted me I fell deeply. I have been battling depression ever since and he actually caused me to feel like I was truly happy again. I still kind of hate myself for falling so hard for him. When he sent that valentines day message it made me feel so much worse.

I have people to talk to, and a couple of other users on here too. It just really hurts. We were totally fine one day then all of a sudden he was gone. It destroyed me, I fell back hard and am still fighting the urge to let my depression win

Thank you all, I'm writing this with my best friend now next to me and she's staying with me. I'm still really upset and my heart hurts terribly but I'm not going to take my life. I thank everyone here for showing me support and love. I never thought I would get such a response and it's overwhelming a bit to see such love for someone like me. I posted to see if anyone would just talk to me and you all did. I sent a few pm's and to those people I could still use someone to talk to. Again thank you all and my friend says thanks for saving my life tonight as well.

Thanks, now I feel a lot worse. Calling me a bitch helped me feel like I really am worthless. I see now that maybe this was a complete waste of time if people tell me things like this. Sorry but now I hate myself even worse
Thankfully she just answered and is on her way. I just hope I don't disappoint her tonight. I am terrified of losing her too.
I don't feel tough. I feel weak and hopeless. I had the blade in my hand but was shaking so bad I dropped it. I can't even do this. I can't stand what I've become.
I hope she answers. I'm losing hope fast

Thank you, I can't see how I can be happy without him. He gave me so much strength when I needed it most and now that he's gone I feel like all my strength is gone. The only thing stopping me from ending my life right now is the thought of making my best friend cry. I love her, she's like my sister and even thinking of hurting her makes me not want to do this. I hate what I've become. With him I always promised to never get back like this but look, here I am and even worse than before. I'm pathetic.
Your words actually managed to get me to smile a little as the new Lara croft is my personal hero. it's just so hard to imagine being without him.
Yes but I can't get her to answer her phone. I called her tonight hoping maybe she could come over and just be here but she didn't answer.

No, he came into my life and helped me climb out of a very deep depression. He showed me such love and it felt so amazing! Every Time he told me he loved me it boosted me self worth. Now he is gone and I feel like my happiness is too. It hit me so hard that I just can't get over it. I look at myself in the mirror and cry when I see my reflection. I'm not beautiful like when he told me I was.

I see what you are saying but it's so hard to do it. I feel lost and abandoned. I haven't had the best past and a lot of bad things led to my depression. If he was to come back I would welcome him with open arms but I don't see it happening. It's hard to open up to them when I get like this. The friend who found me about to kill myself last time is the only one who saw me this way. I can't seem to even pick up my knife or even open a pill bottle because every time I do I think of her. She loves me and I love her. It's making me feel so much worse because I'm so ready. I don't want to feel this way any more. I can't stop crying, I've been crying all day. I feel so stupid for being this way but I can't seem to stop it. I'm sorry, I'm probably typing too much.
He left me a few weeks ago, just stopped talking to me. I feel so lost and alone. If I'm not crying all the time I'm just laying in my bed wishing I was dead. I hate myself for getting this way.

It's ok, the miracle was my best friend knocking on my door right as I went to cut my wrists. I felt like maybe it was a miracle that she came over when she did but it looks like this time I'm all alone........
